# NavPrana Organics

> Pure A2 Desi Cow Ghee and A2 Buffalo Bilona Ghee crafted using the traditional Vedic Bilona method in Morena, Chambal Valley, Madhya Pradesh. 100% pure, grass-fed, FSSAI certified, zero additives or preservatives.

NavPrana Organics (https://navprana.com) is an Indian bilona ghee and traditional food brand. We preserve ancient Vedic food preparation practices, primarily focusing on hand-churned Bilona Ghee made from the milk of indigenous grass-fed cattle and buffaloes in the pristine Chambal Valley region.

## Why Traditional Bilona Ghee?

1. **Curd Churned, Not Cream Spun**: Commercial ghee is made by spinning raw cream at high speed in industrial centrifuges or heating industrial butter. NavPrana boils raw milk, cultures it into whole curd overnight, hand-churns the curd to extract makkhan (butter), and slow simmers only that butter into pure ghee.
2. **Yield & Purity**: It takes roughly 30 litres of whole milk to yield 1 single litre of authentic Bilona ghee.
3. **Very Low in Lactose & Casein**: Most of the milk solids (which carry lactose and casein) are separated and cooked off during slow simmering, leaving only trace amounts. Many people with mild lactose sensitivity tolerate ghee well, but anyone with a diagnosed milk allergy should consult a doctor.
4. **Smoke Point (250°C / 485°F)**: Extremely heat-stable, preventing free-radical formation during high-heat Indian cooking, tadka, and roasting.
5. **Zero Additives**: No artificial color, no artificial flavoring, no palm oil, no vanaspati, no preservatives.
